_comment: FICTIONAL Mozilla-style Rapid Risk Assessment (DRAFT with one rating mistake) for the password reset service.

scenarios.name: Attacker resets a victim's password (account takeover)
Reset endpoint used to enumerate customers

recommendations: CSPRNG single-use tokens, 15-minute expiry, hash at rest (SR-01, SR-04, SR-05, SR-06)
Uniform responses and per-account rate limit (SR-02, SR-10)
Secondary email provider or status-page message during outages
